author: Mark Atwood
text: Resolved by the same commit as JMAP-x2gd.51 (commit a189141). The trait-level 'Async vs sync method convention' rustdoc now documents the carve-up explicitly; the limits() rustdoc carries a '# Why sync, not async' section. Closing — if a future production deployment trips on limits() being sync, file a new bead with concrete numbers (tenant count, refresh cadence) rather than reopening this one.
